chars: the blond-streaked young man
the man in the black T-shirt
the American in the white shirt
the long-haired man in the dark jacket
moments.action: In the dim green-lit mahjong parlour the blond-streaked young man is laughing hard; the man in the black T-shirt grins back while the American in the white shirt watches from the side. The laughter settles into a quiet two-shot at the table.

chars: the American in the white shirt
the long-haired man in the dark jacket
the man in the black T-shirt
the blond-streaked young man
moments.action: Wider coverage: the American and the long-haired man stand together facing the seated group by a race-poster wall, then the camera pulls out to the whole gambling den, tiles on the table and a figure crossing to the blue door.

chars: the man in the black T-shirt
the long-haired man in the dark jacket
moments.action: Tight shot/reverse: the man in the black T-shirt leans across the table talking with a sly grin, the long-haired man answers from the doorway. By the last shot the long-haired man has dropped his eyes and the smile is gone.

chars: the American in the white shirt
moments.action: Out on a neon pachinko street the American walks away from a parked orange sports car, stops to count coins in his hand, then turns and looks off toward something at the kerb.

chars: the American in the white shirt
moments.action: One long held take at a street payphone: a hand lifts the green receiver off the hook, and the American listens with his brow tightening, the easy look from the street gone by the end of the call.

chars: the woman in the fur-collar coat
the American in the white shirt
moments.action: Intercut: the woman in the fur-collar coat comes up a shuttered side alley toward camera while the American keeps talking on the payphone. His frown softens into a small smile as she reaches him.

chars: the American in the white shirt
the woman in the fur-collar coat
moments.action: He puts the phone down and turns to find her standing behind him. They talk in over-shoulder singles by the orange car; her smile widens while his grin fades and he goes quiet and serious.

chars: the woman in the fur-collar coat
the American in the white shirt
moments.action: The street conversation runs on in tight singles: she smiles at him, he breaks into a laugh, then both faces settle. By the last shot his grin is gone and he is just holding her look.

chars: the long-haired man in the dark jacket
the American in the white shirt
the woman in the fur-collar coat
moments.action: Cutaway to the pachinko parlour doors: the long-haired man steps out and scans the crowded arcade aisles and vending machines, searching. Back on the street the American smiles at the woman and she holds his gaze.
